decisions.accepted_teaching_depth: Accept the whole borrowed seed-fiber base morph.cotton. Current lexical evidence gives no meaningful cot/ton cut.
decisions.retained_uncertainty: No meaningful current internal division is proposed at this depth; historical borrowing and plant/cloth uses are recorded separately.

decisions.accepted_teaching_depth: Accept actual growth.wool at central animal-fleece scope, including sheep and similar animals. Keep analogical steel/glass wool excluded and distinguish complete lexical IDs in combined catalogs.
decisions.retained_uncertainty: The component scope is animal wool. Analogical glass wool, steel wool and unrelated fibers are not silently accepted; domain and product-material claims remain separate.

decisions.accepted_teaching_depth: Accept the whole prepared-hide base morph.leather. Do not infer an agent er from the spelling.
decisions.retained_uncertainty: The graph is about the lexical material noun, not proof of composition, ethics, suitability or treatment of a real product.

decisions.accepted_teaching_depth: Accept actual growth.plastic as the current material-noun exposure unit. Historical molding/adjectival structure is real; a deeper plast/-ic lesson is possible but is not this graph. Atomic exposure grants no composition mastery.
decisions.retained_uncertainty: Plast and the historical adjectival ic relationship are real. Atomic exposure is not uniquely forced by the sources and does not deny a defensible deeper analysis; any such analysis requires separate evidence and review. No composition mastery is claimed.

decisions.accepted_teaching_depth: Accept actual hourglass constituent growth.part.glass.material. Keep growth.glass drinking vessel and old broad morph.glass exact and separate. Component compatibility must not complete the material noun as the timer.
decisions.retained_uncertainty: Related material and object meanings have shared history, but complete sense IDs and the stored Growth material/vessel distinction must remain separate. A material source can serve hourglass without becoming the timer target.

decisions.accepted_teaching_depth: Accept new morph.ceramic as a bounded current material-noun exposure choice. Greek clay-base/adjectival structure remains acknowledged; this does not establish monomorphemicity or prohibit a separately reviewed deeper analysis.
decisions.retained_uncertainty: This is a limited pedagogical choice, not evidence that ceramic is historically monomorphemic. Ceram-related classical analysis is possible in a different lesson; independent reviewers must explicitly assess this chosen depth. The stored material definition and domain hold stay exact.

decisions.accepted_teaching_depth: Accept existing morph.metal as the whole material base. The ordinary qualified definition includes alloys without inventing met/al structure or claiming universal chemical properties.
decisions.retained_uncertainty: The stored ordinary material sense includes alloys and typical properties. This pass does not expand it into specialist chemistry, prove universal properties, or approve a handling procedure.

decisions.accepted_teaching_depth: Accept actual growth.wood for tree substance, also observed in woodpecker. Complete woodland, object and bird meanings remain separately attributed.
decisions.retained_uncertainty: Material, woodland and individual wooden-object uses are distinct completed meanings. A compatible component is not automatic approval of a compound or a specialist product.

decisions.accepted_teaching_depth: Accept ordered growth.card plus growth.part.board.sheet, with exact closed spelling and no breaks. This matches actual Growth paper-card scope. Distinct Growth and Professional completed IDs must produce expected combined-catalog ambiguous_sense; target selection is required.
decisions.retained_uncertainty: The candidate deliberately aligns with the existing Growth paper-card component scope rather than creating a stricter material-only card identity. The separate lexical targets can cause a genuine ambiguous_sense merge in a combined catalog. No broad morph.card or morph.board migration or payment-card compatibility is granted.

decisions.accepted_teaching_depth: Accept ordered new morph.part.tissue.wrapping-paper plus growth.paper with exact phrase spelling and root break [7]. The independent dictionary evidence supports the wrapping sense; old fabric history is retained with uncertainty. Keep actual Growth facial tissue and Professional biological/facial tissue separate, and add no short accepted answer.
decisions.retained_uncertainty: The older cloth-based naming account is recorded with the source uncertainty. Current wrapping tissue is an attested noun sense; this proposal does not assert that wrapping and facial tissues are unrelated historically. The full phrase alone remains the accepted language form, with a single exact space and no new shorter answer.

Every non-morphology field, including historical lexical-review notes, all seven domain holds, Growth records, related families, expressions, and course/module release gates remain exact. Eight atomic graphs grant exposure only. Plastic and ceramic retain explicit historical/adjectival teaching-depth limitations.

source.scope: Occupational context for account questions, orders, billing, complaints, records, and referrals across communication channels. Duties vary by industry; specialized finance and insurance work can require additional authorization. This is not term-level review.

source.scope: The 2026 occupation page was consulted for communication, recordkeeping, billing, complaint referral, and work coordination. source.title: Principle (c): Data minimisation
source.scope: UK data-protection context for sufficient, relevant, purpose-limited information. The page explicitly says it is under review following the Data (Use and Access) Act and may change. source.title: How To Spot, Avoid, and Report Tech Support Scams
source.scope: Context for impersonation, pressure, remote-access requests, and fake service or refund claims. The draft teaches reporting and approved contact routes, not scam scripts, credential collection, incident-response techniques, or universal payment-reversal rights.

source.title: General Office Clerks
source.scope: Context for varied clerical work including documents, correspondence, data entry, schedules, and office equipment. Duties depend on the office and assigned role. The draft does not grant authority to perform financial, technical, legal, or healthcare tasks.

source.title: 43-6014.00 - Secretaries and Administrative Assistants, Except Legal, Medical, and Executive
source.scope: The occupation-specific task overview was consulted for files, messages, calendars, meetings, documents, supplies, and travel coordination. Listed tasks are not universal permissions or a word-frequency ranking.

source.title: Scheduling Records
source.publisher: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
source.scope: Context for records categories, retention, authorized disposition, scope, and superseded schedules. The page concerns U.S. federal records; its legal rules and periods are not universal office requirements. No retention period, disposal instruction, or automatic permission is adopted. Current local schedules, holds, and authorized review still apply.

source.title: Making Events Accessible
source.scope: Context for individual access requirements, accessible venues and platforms, materials in advance, captions, and participation in remote, in-person, and hybrid events. Screen sharing alone may not provide accessible content. The page displayed an update date of 31 August 2022; consultation is not a compliance certification or review of a specific event.

source.title: eTools: Computer Workstations
source.scope: The overview was consulted for workstation vocabulary and the need to fit work to individual people. It says no single arrangement fits everyone and that eTools do not create new OSHA requirements. No posture prescription, numeric setup, equipment-use method, emergency procedure, or legal compliance conclusion is taught. Linked detailed component pages were not consulted.

source.title: Hand Laborers and Material Movers
source.scope: Broad occupational context for manual movement, packing, stock, and order-filling work. The group includes occupations outside warehousing; its employment total is not the population of one warehouse role or a vocabulary-frequency ranking. No lifting, cleaning, machine-feeding, repair, or driving procedure is adopted.

source.title: 53-7065.00 - Stockers and Order Fillers

source.title: Warehousing
source.scope: The overview was consulted for powered industrial trucks, ergonomics, materials handling, chemicals, slip/trip/fall, and robotics concerns. Linked standards and detailed hazard pages were not consulted. No equipment method, lifting technique, load calculation, emergency sequence, or energy-isolation procedure is adopted.

source.title: Warehousing

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: price

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: cost

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: subtotal

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: balance

source.title: GOV.UK: How VAT works
source.scope: Selected passage: Overview. The source expands VAT as Value Added Tax and identifies it as a tax on products and services supplied by VAT-registered businesses. source.title: GOV.UK: Where you see VAT
source.scope: Selected passage: In shops; On bills and receipts. A separate VAT line may show tax already included in a retail price. A displayed tax line must not automatically be added again. Limits: UK illustration of why price components need checking, not a universal display rule or a tax calculation for the fictional lesson.

source.title: ECB: What is the role of exchange rates?
source.scope: Selected passage: What are exchange rates?; reference rates. An exchange rate converts between currencies. Published reference rates may differ from actual transaction rates. Limits: Lexical and reference-rate distinction only. No rate, fee, preferred currency or currency-conversion advice is supplied.

source.title: Stripe: Coupons and promotion codes
source.scope: Selected passage: Coupons versus promotion codes; Set a minimum amount. A customer-facing code applies an offer subject to restrictions. A minimum order value can determine whether the code is usable. Limits: The provider's API distinction between coupons and codes is not imposed on ordinary English. No actual discount, minimum amount or automatic entitlement is promised.

source.title: Adyen: Create an authorisation
source.scope: Selected passage: Response authCode field. The response has an authorization code after successful authorization and an empty field when authorization fails. The field is a transaction reference, not a customer PIN. Limits: One API field supports the selected meaning; the code is not proof of capture, settlement or payout. No card data or live processing is involved.

source.title: Adyen: Payments lifecycle
source.scope: Selected passage: Authorization statuses; Capture and settlement statuses. Authorization reserves funds and is distinct from capture and settlement. A refused request is not approved; later statuses must be checked separately. Limits: Provider-specific lifecycle explanation, not operational instructions or a universal status model. No code alone establishes final payment.

source.title: Stripe: Card declines
source.scope: Selected passage: Card declines; Declined card retries. A card issuer may decline an attempted transaction for several reasons. The advice code can prohibit another attempt, so a lesson must not presume retry is appropriate. Limits: Provider-specific evidence for neutral wording. No cause of this fictional decline, retry count, collection advice or authorization to retry is claimed.

source.title: Shopify: Multiple and partial payments on Shopify POS
source.scope: Selected passage: Accept split payment methods for an entire order. One order can be paid using more than one method. The page separately describes partial balances, supporting a distinction from a scheduled installment. Limits: Platform-specific feature with restrictions. No capability, eligibility, procedure or later-payment arrangement is promised for every shop.

source.title: Shopify: Managing Shopify POS receipts
source.scope: Selected passage: Introduction; Send a receipt after a sale. Receipts can be printed or sent electronically. A gift receipt is proof of purchase without the amount spent in this implementation. Limits: Provider-specific availability and regional names remain local to the source. The lesson distinguishes format from gift purpose and asks what is available.

source.title: ACCC: Receipts, bills, proof of purchase
source.scope: Selected passage: Businesses can ask for proof of purchase. Purchase evidence can include a receipt, payment statement or other records linking the buyer and item to the purchase. A receipt is one possible kind of evidence. Limits: Australian guidance only. No evidence sufficiency, mandatory receipt-only policy or universal remedy entitlement is adopted.

source.title: Shopify: Setting up return and cancellation rules
source.scope: Selected passage: Return window. The period and the event that starts it are configurable, and rules can vary by market. The term therefore needs an arrangement-specific definition. Limits: Platform-specific examples only. No duration, start date, fee, exclusion or limit on statutory rights is applied to the lesson.

source.title: GOV.UK: Accepting returns and giving refunds
source.scope: Selected passage: Opening consumer-rights distinction. A seller cannot remove applicable consumer rights through a no-refund statement. Stated store arrangements and legal rights must be kept distinct. Limits: UK guidance illustrates the limitation only. No rule, deadline, entitlement or legal conclusion is generalized to an unspecified jurisdiction.

source.title: FTC: Warranties
source.scope: Selected passage: Introduction; Written Warranties; Spoken Warranties. A product warranty is a seller or manufacturer assurance with specific coverage and limits. Terms can concern repair, replacement or refund; spoken promises are also discussed. Limits: US guidance only. No mandatory coverage, claim process, free remedy or legal right is asserted for a fictional product.

review.notes: Retain the whole borrowed seed-fiber noun and existing morph.cotton identity. Do not divide the spelling into cot and ton or infer any claim about a photographed product. review.draft_author: Codex retail_content (AI source consultation; not human or specialist approval)
review.notes: Use the actual reviewed Growth animal-fiber base. The Professional definition includes sheep and similar animals; its central material meaning matches the Growth sheep-fiber entry. This pending candidate alone changes family identity; old morph.wool remains preserved. The component scope is animal wool. Analogical glass wool, steel wool and unrelated fibers are not silently accepted; domain and product-material claims remain separate.

review.draft_author: Codex retail_content (AI source consultation; not human or specialist approval)
review.notes: Retain the existing whole prepared-hide noun. The final er is not an English agent ending here, and no leath base is invented. The graph is about the lexical material noun, not proof of composition, ethics, suitability or treatment of a real product.

review.draft_author: Codex retail_content (AI source consultation; not human or specialist approval)
review.notes: Align the manufactured-material noun with actual Growth plastic. Choose the whole current noun as an exposure unit while recording its adjective conversion and Greek-derived structure. Plast and the historical adjectival ic relationship are real. Atomic exposure is not uniquely forced by the sources and does not deny a defensible deeper analysis; any such analysis requires separate evidence and review. No composition mastery is claimed.

review.draft_author: Codex retail_content (AI source consultation; not human or specialist approval)
review.notes: Use the actual reviewed hourglass material constituent. The Growth whole glass record means a drinking vessel and has a different pair. Old morph.glass also occurs in vessel and lens compounds and remains unchanged. Related material and object meanings have shared history, but complete sense IDs and the stored Growth material/vessel distinction must remain separate. A material source can serve hourglass without becoming the timer target.

review.draft_author: Codex retail_content (AI source consultation; not human or specialist approval)
review.notes: Propose a new whole material-noun base for the previously null graph. The actual adjective, Greek pottery base and historical ic ending were considered before choosing current-noun exposure depth. This is a limited pedagogical choice, not evidence that ceramic is historically monomorphemic. Ceram-related classical analysis is possible in a different lesson; independent reviewers must explicitly assess this chosen depth. The stored material definition and domain hold stay exact.

review.draft_author: Codex retail_content (AI source consultation; not human or specialist approval)
review.notes: Retain the existing whole material base across metal and related material compounds. No met plus al split is supported by the current noun. The stored ordinary material sense includes alloys and typical properties. This pass does not expand it into specialist chemistry, prove universal properties, or approve a handling procedure.

review.draft_author: Codex retail_content (AI source consultation; not human or specialist approval)
review.notes: Use actual reviewed Growth wood for tree-derived material. The woodpecker constituent provides another real compatible material occurrence. Keep old Professional morph.wood and plywood exact. Material, woodland and individual wooden-object uses are distinct completed meanings. A compatible component is not automatic approval of a compound or a specialist product.

review.draft_author: Codex retail_content (AI source consultation; not human or specialist approval)
review.notes: Use two meaningful modern constituents with exact closed spelling: card plus board in its stiff sheet sense. The actual reviewed Growth cardboard graph already uses these exact pairs, and actual Growth card supplies the same paper-card constituent. The candidate deliberately aligns with the existing Growth paper-card component scope rather than creating a stricter material-only card identity. The separate lexical targets can cause a genuine ambiguous_sense merge in a combined catalog. No broad morph.card or morph.board migration or payment-card compatibility is granted.

review.draft_author: Codex retail_content (AI source consultation; not human or specialist approval)
review.notes: Preserve the ordered two-word expression at current constituent depth: wrapping-paper tissue plus the paper-material base. Introduce a bounded tissue identity to avoid the existing mixed biological/facial family and the narrower Growth facial tissue. The paper base has actual reviewed Growth paper and several compound donors. The older cloth-based naming account is recorded with the source uncertainty. Current wrapping tissue is an attested noun sense; this proposal does not assert that wrapping and facial tissues are unrelated historically. The full phrase alone remains the accepted language form, with a single exact space and no new shorter answer.
